title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Gutter icons that came back on their own
summary: Switching the drawable thumbnails off while they were being rendered brought them straight back.

highlights.title: The render outlived the switch
highlights.description: Rendering yields once per icon. Turning the setting off starts a render that clears, and it finished before the one still in flight, which then put every icon back.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Drawable gutter thumbnails stay off once switched off, even mid render.
